decisions.reason: A formwork profile system with its own page sits close to the core offer, costs little to keep, and has had only one year to show its value, so the option stays open.
Automated concrete distributor flow control fits the firm's automation growth strategy and its value is still uncertain, so keeping this low-cost option preserves upside.
The shuttering magnet block is only mentioned on the website and overlaps with other magnetic products, but keeping a cheap catalogue item costs little while demand is still unclear.
Magnetic formwork strips have their own page and complement the core formwork line, so the low carrying cost justifies keeping them.
This magnetic formwork component has a dedicated page and adds to the firm's modular formwork range, and one year of results does not reveal enough to abandon it.
This magnetic component is only mentioned and is somewhat redundant with E, so its drop risk is higher, but the evidence is too thin and keeping it too cheap to justify dropping it now.
